crossing_criterion: f < ceil((p+b+1)/2); under f=c,b=c+1 requires p>=c-1

forest_certificate: all c remainder vertices induce a star forest; retaining a hub forces a vertex cover of every internal edge, and retaining both hubs permits at most one remainder vertex
bipartite_certificate: delete star center to retain both hubs and c-1 remainder vertices; triangle hitting gives matching upper bound c+1
path_cover_certificate: a spanning linear forest selects at most two internal edges because the star center has degree <=2 and at most four hub-incidence edges because X,Y each have degree <=2, hence at most six edges; emitted witnesses attain six and p=n-6=c-4
